meta.name: concept-attestation
meta.description: The frozen expectation k/40 is judged against. For each witness root: its distinct Quranic uses, each with a gloss and one verse reference, recorded and committed BEFORE that root's concept was generated — then a per-use verdict once the concept exists.
meta.state: FROZEN, AWAITING GENERATION. All 40 witness roots have their uses[] on file and not one concept has been generated for any of them. That is the state §D9 step 1 requires, and it is committed as its own step precisely so it exists in the history as a fact rather than as a claim made afterwards.
the_ordering_is_the_protocol: A root's `uses[]` is written and committed FIRST, from morphology.json's occurrence list and the aṣl's verbatim, with the concept not yet generated.
The concept is generated afterwards, blind: nothing under linguistics/lisan/concept/ may read the aṣl, and an import boundary enforces it rather than a promise.
Only then is each use judged `covered` or `not_covered`, and `concept_recorded_at` stamped.

Written the other way round, «does the concept cover its uses» has no answer: the list quietly shapes itself around what the sentence happens to say, silently and in good faith. Nothing downstream can detect that, so scripts/validate_concept_datasets.py detects it here by refusing to print the metric and naming the roots.
meta.no_partial_credit: A use is `covered` or it is not, and a root counts toward k only when EVERY one of its uses is covered. There is no weighting, no «mostly», and no grade between the two. A root with no `uses[]` on file is `not_recorded` — never `covers_all`: an empty list must never read as full coverage.
meta.a_miss_is_a_result: A root whose concept fails to cover an attested use is recorded as a miss with one line of reason, and that record is NEVER a reason to add a table row, reglossed a primitive, re-order the rarity rule or add an exception. The primitive table moves only through a lock version justified by a feature-level authority. Agreement with Ibn Fāris is attestation, not calibration.
meta.audit: Audit is POSSIBLE, not performed. There is no second judge: the curator writes the verdicts. What is committed here — the frozen uses, the verdict and its reason, beside the generated concept and its lock version — is everything a reader who clones the repository needs to redo the judgement and disagree. No claim of independent review is made anywhere.
meta.counts_toward_k: Records may exist for roots outside the 40-root holdout in `concept_witness_set.json`; they are published like any other and counted in neither half of k/40. «ضرب» is the declared development case: §D5's composition rule was verified against it, so coverage measured on it proves nothing, and it is confronted and published without contributing to the number.

<qac root key>.concept_recorded_at: <ISO-8601 timestamp — when the concept was generated, and it must be LATER>
<qac root key>.commit: <optional: the commit uses[] was frozen in; the timestamps are what the validator orders>

uses.gloss: <one Quranic sense of the root, in Arabic>
uses.verse: <s:a — a verse of this root that carries that sense>
uses.reason: <one line; required on not_covered, and the thing that makes the judgement redoable>

record_shape._note: This block documents the shape and is NOT a record. Records live under `roots`, which is empty.

readers: linguistics/lisan/concept/confront.py — reads it, compares, and reports; it has no path that re-ranks, re-selects or re-phrases a concept.
scripts/validate_concept_datasets.py — the ordering gate and the k/40 printer.
how_these_uses_were_written: Source: morphology.json's occurrence list for the root, and Ibn Fāris' aṣl verbatim from maqayis_asl.csv — the two §D9 step 1 names, and nothing else.

The generated concept was NOT consulted. Stated exactly, because the exact version is what the metric rests on: the curator read no witness root's concept before writing these uses. One witness root — قوم — WAS composed before the freeze, inside a test run of confront.py; its concept was never recorded in this file, never displayed, and never read by the person writing these uses. The claim this file makes is about the curator's knowledge and about the stamped ordering, not about whether the composer function was ever called in a test.
Every `verse` is one of that root's OWN occurrence verses, checked mechanically. A use evidenced by a verse where the root does not occur is not an attested use of it.

Senses are the distinct Quranic uses the curator can defend, not an exhaustive lexicon. A coarser list is easier to cover and would flatter k/40; a finer one is harder. Neither was tuned, because the concepts did not exist to tune against.

verdict_vocabulary.not_judged: the use is frozen and its concept does not exist yet — the mandated intermediate state, and the only verdict legal before generation
verdict_vocabulary.covered: the generated concept reaches this use
verdict_vocabulary.not_covered: it does not; a miss carries its one-line reason and is a RESULT, never a reason to edit the table

coverage_criterion.declared: 2026-09-25, in its own commit, BEFORE any witness root's concept was generated — the same ordering discipline as uses[] themselves, one layer in. §D9 said «judge coverage» without saying what coverage is; a judge with no written criterion applies one anyway and discovers it while judging.
coverage_criterion.rule: A use is `covered` when a reader given ONLY the realised primitives, in their positional order, and told nothing about the root, would recognise that use's notion as something the reading says.
tests_all_necessary: nothing imported — every content notion of the gloss traces to at least one realised primitive; if the step from primitives to gloss needs a notion the nine do not carry, it is not covered

not merely inert — the primitives must do more than fail to contradict the gloss; at least one realised primitive must carry the gloss's CENTRAL notion. Nine notions are compatible with almost anything, so «does not contradict» is the failure mode this reading is most prone to
the direction holds — opens → body → concludes is part of the claim; a gloss needing the root to end in an opening-out is not covered by a reading whose third position is قَطْع
coverage_criterion.the_prohibition: The judge may not use what they know the root means to build the bridge. Knowing that قوم is standing makes «أَصْل · ظُهور» look like a foundation; it looks like one only to someone who already has the answer. Where the bridge needs the root's meaning, the verdict is not_covered.

miss_classes.imported: the gloss needs a notion absent from the realised primitives
miss_classes.inert: the primitives are compatible with the gloss and say nothing about it
miss_classes.direction: the positional order contradicts the gloss
miss_classes.collision: another root with a divergent aṣl composes to these exact realised primitives, so nothing in this reading is about this root

coverage_criterion.why_the_classes: §D3's reopening condition requires collision failures to be strictly more than half of all failing roots, classified on the per-root reasons ALREADY COMMITTED. That is only checkable if the reasons were classified when they were written, against a vocabulary fixed beforehand. This is that vocabulary, and every `not_covered` reason opens with one of the four words.
coverage_criterion.collision_is_computed_afterwards: Whether another QAC root composes to the same realised primitives is a mechanical fact about the table, not a judgement. It is recorded per root as `collision_with` and derived AFTER the judging pass, so that knowing a root collides cannot soften or harden the reading of its uses. The criterion above never mentions collision: a use fails on the three tests before anyone asks why.

meta.the_development_case_record: «ضرب» carries a record here and is NOT a witness root. Its five uses are the ones §D9 names from the brief — الضرب باليد · الضرب في الأرض · ضرب الأمثال · ضرب الحاجز · «وضُرِبت عليهم الذلة» — and each is evidenced by one of its own occurrence verses. Its record does NOT and cannot claim the freeze-before-generate ordering the 40 claim: its concept has been read since §D5 was written, which is exactly why §D9 excludes it from k. Recording it with honest stamps and an explicit exemption is the whole point — a quiet absence on the flagship case would read as a pass.
